methods.name: protocol.describe
methods.description: Read the protocol version, method schemas and backend guarantees. Does not start an engine or open a session.

methods.name: session.create
methods.description: Create one new game. Returns its sessionId, revision, full perceived observation and any genuine choice. With no arguments, randomize the seed and character and generate a hero name in C. Omitted names are derived from the seed; omitted role/race/gender/alignment are selected compatibly by the engine. Supplied fields are preserved. Profile 1 records a fixed UTC creation calendar and isolates user options/configuration. A seed alone is not a full world identity; calendar, pinned engine/data and target matter. Creation is NOT retry-idempotent: retain the returned sessionId; do not blindly retry after a transport failure.

methods.name: session.observe
methods.description: Read the currently loaded session's full observation and standing decision. No engine input, game turn, revision change or event consumption. Does not resume an unloaded session. A cached receipt is historical; observe for current state.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier returned by create or resume.

methods.name: session.actions
methods.description: Read revision-bound attempts for here or an adjacent square using only perceived knowledge. No engine input, event consumption, receipt or automatic resume. Offers do not promise safety or success.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier returned by create or resume.

methods.name: session.resume
methods.description: Re-enter a persisted session by replaying validated input with its pinned engine. Restores the recorded runtime profile, observation and pending decision without answering it. Unprofiled history is refused, not migrated with invented settings. Matching prompts are not a universal replay proof. Requires exclusive ownership. Integrity or uncertain-boundary failures block new operations. This runs an engine; archive review is a separate, read-only client facility.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier returned by create or resume.

methods.name: session.close
methods.description: Retire the loaded session's engine and release ownership, retaining journals and pending decisions for resume. A loaded terminal world whose engine already retired closes as a no-op. Does not quit, kill the hero, delete the game or answer a warning. Check returned storage health; do not assume a transport timeout means the close succeeded.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier returned by create or resume.

methods.name: game.move
methods.description: Attempt exactly one adjacent step. Normal NetHack bump behavior can attack, open a door or exchange places with an ally. Meaningful warnings require consent. Direction is a compass word, not a key. Returns outcome, ordered events, full observation and at most one decision. Answer a decision separately; never repeat this operation to continue it.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier returned by create or resume.

requestId.description: Unique operation ID. On a timeout retry this exact ID and payload; never create a new ID to retry.

expectedRevision.description: Revision of the observation on which this operation is based. Not game time. Known retries are checked before this guard.

methods.name: game.wait
